changelog:
Seeing which source a title came from, and turning sources on and off.

**Sources**
- Movies and Series now show the source's colour beside each title, the same
  marking live channels already had. It sits next to the name, not over the
  artwork.
- Settings can turn a source off and back on. Until now nothing could: the app
  could disable an expired line by itself, but you could not, so there was no way
  to look at one provider's catalog on its own.
- A source you turn off stays off. It is not switched back on by a refresh — only
  a line the app disabled by itself comes back on its own.
- With every source turned off, the catalog now says so and tells you where to
  turn one back on, instead of showing the first-run "no sources yet" screen.

**Plex**
- Adding a Plex server works end to end and imports its films and shows.

**Still not proven**
- Playing a Plex item has never succeeded.

Known limits: multi-view, picture-in-picture, DVR and recording are not in this
build. Catch-up still has not been tested against a real provider archive.
